name: Clinton Presidential Center
unique: A presidential library on the Arkansas River with the Oval Office, the campaign memorabilia and a park and bridge on the riverfront.
buzz: The exhibits are well done and the river park is free. Allow two hours.

name: Little Rock Central High School National Historic Site
unique: The school at the center of the 1957 desegregation crisis, with a visitor center across the street and ranger led walks.
buzz: The rangers tell the story with people who lived it, and the school is still operating. Powerful and free.

name: Arkansas Museum of Fine Arts
unique: A rebuilt art museum with a strong collection of American and Southern art, a sculpture garden and a restaurant.
buzz: The renovation is impressive and the collection is free on some days. Good rainy day stop.

name: River Market District
unique: A downtown market hall, food stalls, a farmers market and the riverfront park, connected by a streetcar to the museums.
buzz: The market is the lunch stop and the river walk is the stroll. Busy on Saturday mornings.

name: Garvan Woodland Gardens
unique: Two hundred acres of gardens on a Lake Hamilton peninsula, with a glass chapel, a bonsai collection and a children's garden.
buzz: The Anthony Chapel is the photo and the gardens are beautiful in every season. Holiday lights are a big draw.

name: Oaklawn Racing
unique: A historic thoroughbred track with a casino, a grandstand and a racing season that has run for over a century.
buzz: The cheap seats are close to the rail and the corned beef is a local tradition. Check the racing calendar.

name: Walmart Museum
unique: A museum in Sam Walton's original five and dime, with the first store, the pickup truck and the story of the retail empire.
buzz: Free and more interesting than expected, especially for anyone in business. The soda fountain is still there.

name: The Momentary
unique: A contemporary art satellite of Crystal Bridges in a former cheese factory, with exhibitions, a rooftop bar and live music.
buzz: The industrial space and the programming are both good, and the bar makes it a evening stop.

name: Eureka Springs Historic District
unique: A Victorian mountain town of steep streets, stone walls, springs and a loop of shops and inns, built around healing water.
buzz: The town is hilly and charming, with a famous passion play and a haunted hotel. Park and walk.

name: Thorncrown Chapel
unique: A glass and wood chapel in the woods by Fay Jones, with 425 windows and no walls, an AIA landmark.
buzz: The light and the trees are the experience, and it is free. Go on a weekday morning for quiet.

name: Hemmed-in-Hollow Falls
unique: A 209 foot waterfall, the tallest between the Rockies and the Appalachians, reached by a steep trail from the Buffalo River.
buzz: The hike is rough and the reward is real. Bring water and check the river level.

name: Blanchard Springs Caverns
unique: A living cave with guided tours through cathedral sized rooms, flowstone and a underground stream, run by the Forest Service.
buzz: The living cave is the real thing, not a commercial show cave. Book the longer tour.

name: Petit Jean State Park
unique: Arkansas's first state park, with Cedar Falls, a canyon, a lodge built by the CCC and trails through the Ouachita foothills.
buzz: Cedar Falls is the hike and the lodge is the sleep. Go after rain for the waterfall.

name: Mount Magazine State Park
unique: The highest point in Arkansas, with a lodge on the rim, hang gliding, trails and a view over the Arkansas River valley.
buzz: The drive up is the adventure and the overlooks are the payoff. The lodge is a good base.

name: Arkansas Railroad Museum
unique: A museum in the old Cotton Belt shops with locomotives, cabooses and a steam engine you can climb on.
buzz: Volunteers run it and the engines are close enough to touch. Cheap and good for kids.

name: Dickson Street
unique: A street of bars, restaurants and music venues next to the university, with the Walton Arts Center at one end.
buzz: Busy on weekends and game days, with good local music. Walk it before a show.

name: Fort Smith National Historic Site
unique: A frontier fort and federal courthouse with the gallows, the jail and the story of the Trail of Tears passing through.
buzz: The courtroom and the gallows are the sobering highlights, and the rangers tell the story well.

name: Delta Cultural Center
unique: A museum of Delta music and life in a former railroad depot, with the King Biscuit Time radio show and the blues trail.
buzz: The music exhibits are excellent and free, and the town is ground zero for Delta blues radio.
